<@508125616940515329> <@543900561460822016> What is the latest on https://discord.com/channels/595666850260713488/753271902520213625/1277584002236284988
?

Unless I'm missing something, the current 7702 spec suggests a cap on 7702 authority gas refund (20% of the execution gas), which is the normal refund flow.

However, if the original idea was to charge the empty account gas for all the auth tuples and then provide refund for all non-empty authority accounts, a cap on this refund seems a bit odd.
